chapters.label: The last minute
chapters.text: Dresden, 2011. The USA are losing to Brazil, and extra time is almost over. Megan Rapinoe crosses with her left foot... Abby Wambach heads it in! Two-all!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Wambach times her run to the far post, jumps above the keeper, and meets the ball with her forehead.

chapters.label: Penalties
chapters.text: Now, penalties! Hope Solo dives and saves one, and the USA win the shootout!

chapters.label: Never give up
chapters.text: Never give up, even in the last minute! Time your run, jump, and meet the ball with your forehead.
